actions.description: hold Up arrow: next move goes up (y - 1); also restarts on the end screen
hold Down arrow: next move goes down (y + 1)
hold Left arrow: next move goes left (x - 1)
hold Right arrow: next move goes right (x + 1)
click the centre of the game (menu start)

notes: If playing is false (menu or end screen), use waitTicks % 4: 1 -> key_up (restart), 3 -> start, 0 or 2 -> wait. While playing, each direction X in up, down, left, right has four fields. XOk means moving there does not hit the wall or the body right away. XSafe means that after the move the snake can still reach its own tail or has at least 2 x length cells of room. XCoin is the number of steps from there to the coin (0 means it eats the coin now, 99 means unreachable). XRoom is the number of cells reachable after the move. If any XSafe is true, choose among the safe directions: smallest XCoin first, then larger XRoom, then the direction equal to heading, otherwise the first in the order up, down, left, right. If no direction is safe, choose among the XOk directions: largest XRoom first, then smaller XCoin, then heading. If none is Ok, keep heading. The action is key_X for the chosen X. unknown* fields (if present) describe an unrecognised object that is already treated as a blocked cell.
